inj.note: Santos put the first points on the board with a 43-yard field goal in the first quarter and added a 31-yarder in the second. He had a chance to give Chicago a two-score lead midway through the fourth quarter but clanged a 53-yard attempt off the right upright. However, Santos atoned for that miss in dramatic fashion, knocking in a 58-yard field goal -- the longest make of his career -- with less than two minutes remaining to essentially seal the win for the Bears. He's now 11-for-15 on field-goal tries this season, including 3-for-5 from 50-plus yards.

news.h: Bears' Santos gets redemption with game-sealing FG after 'annoying' miss vs. Pats
news.d: Bears kicker Cairo Santos walked away from Thursday's win over the Patriots a savior despite being haunted by a fourth-quarter miss.
